title: 第一卷 第27章 崖壁隐灵，无人所知
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
西侧崖壁乱石嶙峋，杂草肆意丛生。

    相比谷中繁花遍地、灵泉潺潺的盛景，这里显得格外荒芜冷清。

    整片核心幽谷，所有人的目光，都死死盯着中央开阔地带。

    那里灵气冲天，宝光隐隐，是明面上最顶级的机缘汇聚之地。

    天骄割据，强者争锋，资源丰厚到让人眼红。

    没有任何一名顶尖弟子，愿意多看偏僻崖壁一眼。

    就连四处捡漏的低层弟子，也懒得踏足这片区域。

    在所有人的固有认知里。

    秘境核心的造化，只藏在灵泉、花海、古木之间。

    偏僻乱石崖壁，纯属废地，毫无寻宝价值。

    浪费时间不说，还大概率一无所获。

    可众人不知，最不起眼的荒芜之地，往往藏着最隐蔽的机缘。

    苏玄尘缓步走到崖壁之下。

    他没有急着探寻，而是抬眸静静扫视整片岩壁。

    目光细致沉稳，不放过任何一处石缝、任何一丝异常。

    寻常修士靠肉眼观灵，只能看见外放的磅礴灵气。

    他身怀极品天灵根，五感远超常人。

    再加上百年岁月打磨出的细致心性，能捕捉到最细微的灵气流动。

    片刻观察，他终于锁定了异常来源。

    崖壁诸多乱石缝隙中，唯独一处半人高的幽暗石洞。

    正缓缓溢出一缕极淡、极温润的阴润灵气。

    这丝灵气内敛至极，不冲、不炸、不显山不露水。

    混杂在周遭漫天灵雾之中，几乎完美隐匿。

    若是换做任何一名外门弟子，哪怕九层天骄路过，也绝对无法察觉。

    唯有他，能清晰分辨出，这是地底灵脉独有的气息。

    “石缝藏灵，地底有脉。”

    苏玄尘低声呢喃，眼底掠过一丝了然。

    这片崖壁看似贫瘠，实则连通着秘境残留的微型地底灵脉。

    灵脉微弱，不足以孕育惊天动地的至宝。

    却能日积月累，滋生出最温润、最适合滋养肉身的灵物。

    对争强好胜、追求高阶灵草、上古残页的天骄而言，此地毫无用处。

    零星石乳、缓慢滋养，远不如争抢一次高阶灵药来得实在。

    可落在苏玄尘手中，却是千金不换的绝世机缘。
content_en:
The cliffs on the west side are jagged with rocks and overgrown with weeds.

    Compared with the grand scene of flowers everywhere and gurgling spiritual springs in the valley, this place looks particularly deserted and deserted.

    In the entire core valley, everyone's eyes were fixed on the central open area.

    The aura there is soaring into the sky and the treasure light is faint. It is the place where the best opportunities gather on the surface.

    The geniuses divide the empire, the strong ones compete, and the resources are so abundant that people are envious.

    No top disciple is willing to take another look at a remote cliff.

    Even the low-level disciples who were picking up leaks were too lazy to set foot in this area.

    in everyone’s inherent cognition.

    The creation at the core of the secret realm is only hidden among the spiritual springs, sea of ​​flowers, and ancient trees.

    The remote rocky cliffs are a wasteland with no treasure hunting value.

    Not to mention wasting time, there is a high probability that you will gain nothing.

    But everyone doesn't know that the most inconspicuous and deserted places often hide the most hidden opportunities.

    Su Xuanchen walked slowly to the bottom of the cliff.

    He did not rush to explore, but raised his eyes to scan the entire rock wall quietly.

    His eyes were meticulous and steady, not missing any stone crevice or any abnormality.

    Ordinary monks rely on naked eyes to observe spirits, and can only see the majestic spiritual energy emitted.

    He possesses the highest quality heavenly spiritual roots, and his five senses are far beyond those of ordinary people.

    Coupled with the meticulous mind honed over hundreds of years, it can capture the subtlest flow of spiritual energy.

    After a moment of observation, he finally located the source of the anomaly.

    Among the many stone gaps on the cliff, there is only a dark stone cave that is half a person's height.

    A wisp of extremely light and extremely warm Yin-moist spiritual energy is slowly overflowing.

    This spiritual energy is extremely restrained, neither rushing, nor exploding, nor revealing.

    Mixed into the surrounding spiritual mist, it was almost perfectly hidden.

    If it were any outer disciple, even if a ninth-level genius passed by, he would never be able to detect it.

    Only he can clearly tell that this is the unique aura of the underground spiritual veins.

    "There are spirits hidden in the cracks in the rocks, and there are veins in the ground."

    Su Xuanchen murmured in a low voice, a glimmer of understanding flashing through his eyes.

    This cliff seems barren, but in fact it is connected to the remaining miniature underground spiritual veins in the secret realm.

    The spiritual veins are weak and not enough to give birth to earth-shattering treasures.

    But it can accumulate over time and breed the warmest spiritual things that are most suitable for nourishing the physical body.

    This place is useless to those who are competitive and pursue high-level spiritual herbs and ancient fragments.

    Scattered stone milk and slow nourishment are far less practical than fighting for a high-level elixir.

    But in Su Xuanchen's hands, it was a unique opportunity that could not be exchanged for a lot of money.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 27 Hidden Spirit on the Cliff, No One Knows
